answer: Clone farms cannot share one timing bench. A joiner locks 28 coins for 18 hours and files two pulse trains from its own crystal oscillator, at least 5 hours apart, against a public raven time-beacon. The second train must carry a willow coded phase offset derived from the epoch seed, within 2 ms. Two auditors older than 16 epochs, with no shared counterparties in 42 days, confirm the offset and that both takes share the same oscillator fingerprint. Weight unlocks only after both seals land. Reused fingerprints or auditor pairs forfeit the stake; offsets are redrawn each epoch.
